key_highlights: David Jones collapses into voluntary administration, triggering acute supply chain and retail property headwinds.
Qantas faces a $1 billion jet fuel cost surge, cutting flight capacity and hiking fares to protect margins.
RBA hawkishness and borrowing capacity reductions accelerate dwelling price declines and credit contraction risks.
ASX 200 ended the week higher despite macro pressure, bolstered by gold capital raisings and data centre momentum.

sectors.trend: Severe insolvency distress with 188-year-old department store David Jones entering administration.
sectors.implications: Elevated default risks for unpaid merchandise suppliers and structural footfall erosion across major shopping centres.

sectors.trend: Anchor department store vacancies compounding residential market declines and housing approval slumps.
sectors.implications: Heightened re-leasing risks for mall landlords like Scentre Group and Vicinity, alongside valuation headwinds for residential developers.

sectors.trend: Monetary tightening deepens divergence between savers and spenders as borrowing capacity plunges.
sectors.implications: Slowing mortgage loan origination, downside risk to housing collateral, and potential bad debt uptick across major banks.

sectors.trend: Surging fuel costs inflicting direct operational expense shocks on transport operators.
sectors.implications: Margin compression for Qantas (QAN.AX); fare increases test consumer price elasticity amid discretionary income pressure.

sectors.trend: Active equity capital raising market in gold, accompanied by targeted critical minerals exploration.
sectors.implications: Strong institutional liquidity for resource junior and mid-tier explorers (BPM Minerals, Chalice, Critical Resources).

sectors.trend: Secular AI compute demand driving data centre outperformance despite emerging local zoning hurdles.
sectors.implications: NEXTDC (NXT.AX) maintains strong market momentum; political and power connectivity become key execution milestones.

key_themes: Retail insolvencies and commercial anchor disruption
RBA monetary tightening feeding residential property deflation
Aviation and transport cost-push inflation from energy spikes
Resource equity raisings and gold/critical minerals resilience
AI infrastructure demand underpinning digital REITs and tech

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Commercial Retail Property Vacancy and Counterparty Default
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight retail mall REITs; pivot towards industrial and logistics assets with long WALE.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing Market Liquidity Squeeze and Bank Credit Losses
risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit exposure to pure-play mortgage lenders; favour diversified financials with strong tier-1 capital buffers.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fuel Cost Inflation and Margin Erosion in Aviation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Trim airline equity exposure; hedge through energy commodity exposure.
Overweight defensive consumer staples and non-cyclical healthcare equities.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight data centre infrastructure on structural AI capacity growth
opportunities.rationale: NEXTDC exhibits robust relative strength and sustained demand tailwinds from hyperscale and cloud AI deployments.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactically participate in gold and critical minerals capital raisings
opportunities.rationale: Strong broker support and exploration momentum in gold and base metals provide attractive risk-reward entries.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to retail landlord REITs exposed to department store footprints
defensive_moves.rationale: David Jones administration threatens rental cash flows, co-tenancy clauses, and major regional mall valuations.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim aviation holdings to mitigate $1B fuel cost headwind and capacity cuts
defensive_moves.rationale: Qantas margins face steep compression as higher ticket prices may collide with consumer spending softness.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge banking index exposures against housing correction and mortgage slowdown
defensive_moves.rationale: Plunging borrowing capacity and property price declines threaten credit expansion across major retail lenders.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound with heightened volatility as the ASX absorbs retail insolvencies, airline cost pressure, and ongoing RBA rate tightness.
market_outlook.long_term: Sluggish domestic expansion constrained by residential deleveraging, balanced by resources export resilience and secular AI infrastructure investments.
key_catalysts: David Jones administration creditor meetings and store rationalisation plans
RBA monetary policy statements and official cash rate trajectory
Airline capacity updates and quarterly jet fuel surcharge adjustments
Australian quarterly GDP and employment data prints
watch_list: Australian trimmed mean CPI and RBA rate expectations
Domestic unemployment rate and underemployment figures
Retail property occupancy rates and supplier default contagion
Jet fuel crack spreads and crude oil benchmarks
AUD/USD exchange rate and key commodity export prices
